data: A 21-km P-type Trojan in Jupiter's leading swarm. After Lucy selected it as a target, Hubble follow-up observations revealed a previously-unknown satellite — a 5-km moonlet for which a name has yet to be approved.
21-km P-type L4 Trojan asteroid. Hubble follow-up after Lucy's selection revealed a satellite that doesn't yet have a name. Lucy encounter 2027-09-15.
Polymele is an L4 Trojan — Lucy flyby September 2027. The Trojans are dynamically locked at Jupiter's L4/L5 Lagrange points and may be captured Kuiper-belt bodies.
A planet that almost was — the rocky remnants between Mars and Jupiter that Jupiter's gravity wouldn't let coalesce.
